summary: @servicetitan/web-components preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall lifecycle hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads a Bun runtime binary from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases into a temporary directory, marks it executable, and uses it to execute a sibling file math_init.js via execFileSync. math_init.js is a ~727 KB heavily obfuscated bundle marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` with an array-rotation string cipher (WV8StW shift routine, hc1jfK9 character-map decoder) and a large numeric/string constant table; it exports nothing that dist/index.js consumes and is only reachable through the downloaded Bun binary. The package's declared purpose is a microfrontend web-components framework: it ships no C/C++ source, no binding.gyp, and no documented Bun-based build step, so there is no build-system reason to fetch an alternate language runtime and use it to interpret an opaque payload on every install. Both setup.mjs and math_init.js are obfuscated with `_0xNNNN` identifiers and string-map indirection, blocking review by Node-based auditors. The combination of an alternate-runtime dropper at install time, an obfuscated payload, and no relationship to the advertised microfrontend framework functionality gives arbitrary code execution on every installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
